# File Suite

> Private, browser-first developer tools (JSON, JWT, schema, tokens, diff, cron, files). Tool content is processed in the browser and never stored. Several tools are also available as agent skills and hooks.

## Agent skills & hooks

Install in Claude Code:

    /plugin marketplace add UpadhyayAmit/filesuite
    /plugin install filesuite-devtools@filesuite

- [Agent Skills & Hooks overview](https://www.filesuite.dev/agents)
- jwt-inspector (skill): decode and audit JWTs locally
- json-schema-infer (skill): merge JSON/JSONL samples into a JSON Schema, with a strict mode for LLM tools
- context-budget (skill): estimate tokens per file, check context-window fit, plan RAG chunks
- guard_secrets (hook): block keys and tokens before they are written or committed
- validate_structured (hook): re-parse JSON/JSONL/TOML after every edit
- Source: https://github.com/UpadhyayAmit/filesuite/tree/main/plugins/filesuite-devtools

- [JSON Formatter](https://www.filesuite.dev/tools/json-formatter)

- [All tools](https://www.filesuite.dev/)
